description: This file defines an abstract serializer class for JSON-based objects that implement the Jsonifiable interface, with support for handling DittoHeaders. It's part of a cluster utility package in the Eclipse Ditto project, focusing on serialization and deserialization of JSON objects within an Akka-based system.

classes.name: AbstractJsonifiableWithDittoHeadersSerializer
classes.description: An abstract serializer class for handling JSON serialization and deserialization of Jsonifiable objects with DittoHeaders, supporting strategies for mapping and buffer management.

methods.name: identifier
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for this serializer.

methods.name: manifest
methods.description: Provides a string manifest representing the object type for serialization.

methods.name: toBinary
methods.description: Serializes a Jsonifiable object into a ByteBuffer, handling JsonObject construction and payload serialization.

methods.name: serializeIntoByteBuffer
methods.description: Abstract method to serialize a JsonObject into a ByteBuffer; to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: toBinary
methods.description: Converts a Jsonifiable object directly into a byte array.

methods.name: fromBinary
methods.description: Deserializes a ByteBuffer into a Jsonifiable object based on manifest.

methods.name: tryToCreateKnownJsonifiableFrom
methods.description: Helper method to deserialize ByteBuffer into a known Jsonifiable using a manifest.

methods.name: createJsonifiableFrom
methods.description: Creates a Jsonifiable object from a ByteBuffer and manifest, including extracting payload and headers.

methods.name: deserializeFromByteBuffer
methods.description: Abstract method to deserialize a ByteBuffer into a JsonValue; to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: getPayload
methods.description: Extracts the payload JsonObject from a JsonObject, ensuring correct type.
